entities.summary: Ahmed al-Boukhari was a Moroccan agent of Cab-1, the political cell of the DST. He claimed to have taken part in the operation that orchestrated the abduction and murder of Mehdi Ben Barka, and was as such one of the last surviving possible witnesses in the Benbarka Affair.
